> Yes the PR is here algolia/algoliasearch-magento#233 but it's not really explicit. Basically e-commerce guys want to let the ability for the user to remove the hitsPerPage by clicking on a "View All" button. For us this means having a button to set hitsPerPage to 1000

I don't think having hitsPerPage=1000 is a good idea, do you think an infinite scroll widget could help?
